text: Gotcha for future BEHIND-branch fixes: PUT /pulls/<n>/update-branch creates a merge commit authored via the API with no DCO Signed-off-by trailer, which fails the DCO Sign-Off check even though every original commit was properly signed off (hit this on PR #5464). Fix: git fetch origin, then git rebase origin/v1-development locally, then git push --force-with-lease (not update-branch, and not a plain --force -- the lease refuses to push if the remote ref moved since your fetch). This only applies to a branch you know is solo-owned with no concurrent pushes -- rebasing rewrites commit objects, and CONTRIBUTING.md's review-feedback rule ('address review feedback without rewriting another contributor's work') means a branch that might carry someone else's commits should instead get a locally-created merge commit with its own Signed-off-by trailer added (git merge origin/v1-development --no-ff, then amend the merge commit message to add the trailer before pushing) so DCO passes without rewriting anyone's history. Rebased #5464 onto current v1-development as 612555f50, CI re-running.
